execution_contract: Fresh labelled derivative for each mutation; prove clean baseline first.
Bind baseline/derived/patch SHA-256 and exact unique source span before execution.
Only the explicitly declared derived bytes bypass baseline provenance checks; do not disable ordinary provenance validation.
Compile applicable mutant successfully, then require the named witness and intended semantic category.
Never count missing IDs, a status string, a digest guard or aggregate count alone as mutation detection.
Endpoint omit and config-consumer require BOTH structural and behavioral failures.
